description: This file defines functions and types related to handling channel send results, attaching channels to results, creating empty channel results, and adapters for sending text and media messages over channels. It also includes functions to normalize raw send results into a standardized shape.

methods.name: export function attachChannelToResult<T extends object>(channel: string, result: T) { attachChannelToResult
methods.description: Attaches the specified channel to a result object, returning a new object with the channel property included.

methods.name: export function attachChannelToResults<T extends object>(channel: string, results: readonly T[])/ attachChannelToResults
methods.description: Attaches a channel to each result in an array of results, returning a new array with attached results.

methods.name: export function createEmptyChannelResult( createEmptyChannelResult
methods.description: Creates an empty OutboundDeliveryResult object for a given channel, with optional partial result data.

methods.name: export function createAttachedChannelResultAdapter(params: { createAttachedChannelResultAdapter
methods.description: Creates an adapter object with sendText, sendMedia, and sendPoll methods that attach a channel to each message result.

methods.name: export function createRawChannelSendResultAdapter(params: { createRawChannelSendResultAdapter
methods.description: Creates an adapter for raw send results that attaches the channel and normalizes the result.

methods.name: export function buildChannelSendResult(channel: string, result: ChannelSendRawResult) { buildChannelSendResult
methods.description: Normalizes raw channel send result into a standardized shape, attaching channel info, OK status, message ID, and error if any.
